_about: the PRICKLY PEAR (Opuntia ficus-indica and kin): a sprawling heap of flat oval pads joined end to end, each grown from the rim of the last at its own angle, dotted with tufts of spines and fine barbed bristles; old ones on a short woody trunk; in spring cup-shaped yellow flowers on the pads' rims, then barrel-shaped fruit, red-purple when ripe
